label: suspicious_training_example
subject: URGENT: Your student account closes today
body: Your account will be deleted in 30 minutes. Confirm your password and one-time code at https://campus-login-help.test/verify
discussion_notes: Time pressure and an account-closure threat
Sender and link use an unfamiliar domain
safe_domain_note: The .test top-level domain is reserved for testing and examples. No link should be opened.

label: benign_training_example
subject: Reminder: borrowed book due Friday
body: This is a reminder that your borrowed book is due Friday. Visit the library desk or use the library website you normally use if you need to renew it.
discussion_notes: Expected context matters; a familiar topic alone does not authenticate a sender
No unexpected sign-in link or sensitive-information request is present
safe_domain_note: The .example domain is reserved for documentation. This is fictional sample content.

label: needs_independent_verification
subject: Please review the updated event agenda
body: The agenda for next week's event has changed. Please review the attached document before the planning meeting.
discussion_notes: An attachment can be expected or unexpected depending on context
Confirm unexpected files with the sender through a known contact method
safe_domain_note: The .example domain is reserved for documentation. No real attachment is included.
